note: Chase Total Checking: $15 a month, waived in a statement period with $500 or more of qualifying electronic deposits, a balance of $1,500 or more at the beginning of each day, or an average beginning-day balance of $5,000 or more (the last counting linked accounts, which the game doesn't hold, so this account's alone). Read again 2026-10-30 with Chase's Additional Banking Services and Fees (effective 14 June 2026): Total Checking earns no interest; an item paid into overdraft costs $34 (only once the account is more than $50 overdrawn at the end of the business day, at most three a day, none on an item of $5 or less: the game charges the $34 on each item paid past the balance and doesn't hold the $50 cushion or the cap); the fee schedule names no fee for a returned (unpaid) item and no overdraft rate or limit; Chase ATMs cost nothing, another bank's ATM in the U.S. $3 and one abroad $5, plus the 3% Foreign Exchange Rate Adjustment on any card purchase or withdrawal in another currency (both written; the ATM owner's own surcharge isn't Chase's and isn't held); a transfer at home is read as the online domestic wire, $25 (a banker's is $35; Zelle and ACH transfers carry no Chase fee in the schedule but aren't priced there), and one abroad as the online foreign-currency wire, $5 (free from $5,000; a U.S.-dollar wire online is $40, a banker's $50). Not stated in either document: what opening asks (the product page names no opening deposit). The Chase Savings account ($5 a month, waived at a $300 daily balance or for an owner under 25) is not written: its interest rate is given only by ZIP code on a page that renders it, so no rate was read.
